'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[2023 Givat Shaul shooting]]
***Three [[Israelis|Israeli]] [[civilian]]s are killed and sixteen injured in a [[mass shooting]] in the [[Givat Shaul]] neighborhood of [[Jerusalem]]. Two [[Palestinian political violence|Palestinian gunmen]] are shot and killed by security forces. An armed civilian who shot the Palestinian attackers,  Yuval Doron Castleman, is mistaken for an attacker and is also shot dead. [[Hamas]] claims responsibility for the attack. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog-november-30-2023/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2023-11-30/ty-article/three-israelis-killed-in-jerusalem-attack-hamas-affiliated-assailants-shot-dead/0000018c-1f4a-da36-a1de-5f6fc5200000 (''Haaretz'')]
**[[2023 Israel–Hamas ceasefire]]
***A deal is reached to extend the [[ceasefire]] for at least one more day after it had been due to expire. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/truce-in-gaza-counts-down-to-end-at-7-a-m-thursday-amid-efforts-to-extend/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[Spanish Prime Minister]] [[Pedro Sánchez]] has expressed doubts that [[Israel]] is abiding by [[international law]] in the war, due to the high number of [[Civilian casualty|civilian casualties]] and video footage of growing numbers of children dying. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/30/serious-doubt-israel-complying-with-international-law-spains-sanchez (Al Jazeera)]
**[[United States Secretary of State]] [[Antony Blinken]] steps up calls for Israel to comply with international law and protect civilians during its [[military operation]]s in southern Gaza, while reaffirming [[US]] support. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/30/blinken-pledges-support-for-israel-as-gaza-truce-extend-for-third-time (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Ukraine]] says its [[Security Service of Ukraine|special forces]] bombed a [[freight train]] as it was passing through the [[Severomuysky Tunnel]] in [[Buryatia]], [[Russia]]. Russia's [[Investigative Committee of Russia|Investigative Committee]] acknowledges an [[explosion]] and fire inside the tunnel, and says that a preliminary probe is underway to determine the cause. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraines-sbu-targets-rail-line-deep-inside-russian-siberia-source-2023-11-30/ (Reuters)]
*Gunfire breaks out between the [[National Guard of Guinea-Bissau]] and the [[Presidential Guard of Guinea-Bissau|Presidential Guard]] after the National Guard frees two ministers from the opposition [[PAIGC]] from police custody. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-67586556 (BBC)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/1/heavy-gunfire-heard-overnight-in-guinea-bissau-capital (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Russian grain exports]]
**[[Somalia]] receives 25,000 tons of [[grain]] as [[humanitarian aid]] from [[Russia]]. It is part of an agreement announced at the [[2023 Russia–Africa Summit]] to provide food to [[African nations]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/somalia-receives-25-000-tons-of-grain-from-russia-as-humanitarian-aid/3069465 (Anadolu)]
*The [[insolvency]] of the [[Austria]]n [[Signa Holding]] leads to the insolvency of the [[Germany|German]] [[sporting goods]] retailer {{ill|SportScheck|de}}. [https://www.rbb24.de/wirtschaft/beitrag/2023/11/berlin-brandenburg-sportscheck-insolvent-signa-holding.html (rbb24)]

'''Disasters and incidents'''
*At least 13 people are killed in a [[structure fire|fire]] at a [[hostel]] in [[Almaty]], [[Kazakhstan]], with preliminary reports indicating [[carbon monoxide poisoning]] as the cause of death. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231130-fire-at-dawn-in-kazakhstan-hostel-kills-13 (AFP via France 24)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023 United Nations Climate Change Conference]]
**The [[United Nations Climate Change conference]] opens in [[Dubai]], [[United Arab Emirates]], with an agreement to provide funding to [[least developed countries]] that are most at risk from the effects of [[climate change]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2023/nov/30/agreement-on-loss-and-damage-deal-expected-on-first-day-of-cop28-talks (''The Guardian'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Foreign relations of Argentina]]
**Incoming [[Minister of Foreign Affairs, International Trade and Worship|Foreign Minister]] {{ill|Diana Mondino|es}} announces that [[Argentina]] will not join the [[BRICS]] group of nations, as it already has members of the BRICS bloc as the country's primary [[Foreign trade of Argentina|trading partners]]. [https://www.myind.net/Home/viewArticle/argentina-has-declined-the-invitation-to-join-the-brics (MyInd Markets)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[LGBT rights in Russia]]
**The [[Supreme Court of Russia]] bans the [[LGBT movement]], labelling participants as [[Extremism|extremists]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/top-russian-court-bans-lgbt-movement-extremist-2023-11-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023–24 Bhutanese National Assembly election]]
**Citizens of [[Bhutan]] vote in the [[Two-round system|preliminary round]] of elections to elect members of the [[National Assembly (Bhutan)|National Assembly]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/bhutan-votes-preliminary-round-national-elections-2023-11-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[President of El Salvador|Salvadoran President]] [[Nayib Bukele]] is granted a [[leave of absence]] prior to the [[2024 Salvadoran general election|2024 general election]] and is succeeded by his private secretary [[Claudia Rodríguez de Guevara]] as acting president. [https://www.laprensagrafica.com/elsalvador/Asamblea-otorga-permiso-a-Bukele-para-que-realice-campana-20231130-0091.html (La Prensa Gráfica)]
